text: Converting Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) Ephemeris Time (ET) complex. due unpredictable nature Earth's rotation, basis UTC, whereas ET based uniform orbital motion Earth around Sun. key converting time scales lies value known delta-T, difference uniform time scale one based Earth's rotation. conversion handled : ET = UTC + deltaT However, delta-T constant value calculated using simple formula. delta-T values derived historical records direct observations. series polynomial expressions created simplify evaluation delta-T. calculated values valid years -1999 +3000.
